tags.name: start_pb
tags.comment: IN1 (di0): Start push button, N.O. momentary; 1 = pressed

tags.name: stop_pb
tags.comment: IN2 (di1): Stop push button, N.O. momentary; 1 = pressed (no N.C. button in kit)

tags.name: estop_ok
tags.comment: IN3 (di2): E-stop slide switch wired N.C.; 1 = healthy, 0 = tripped or wire cut

tags.name: reset_pb
tags.comment: IN4 (di3): Fault reset push button, N.O. momentary; 1 = pressed

tags.name: reset_edge
tags.comment: One-scan pulse on a new reset_pb press

tags.name: start_released
tags.comment: 1 when start_pb was released last scan; Start needs a new press

tags.name: motor
tags.comment: RELAY 1 (relay0) N.O.: motor interposing relay coil; seals in

tags.name: run_light
tags.comment: RELAY 2 (relay1) N.O.: green run light; follows motor

tags.name: fault_lamp
tags.comment: RELAY 4 (relay3) N.O.: red fault lamp; it IS the latched E-stop fault
